summary: Apollomics Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on July 14, 2026, reporting that it regained compliance with Nasdaq's Market Value of Listed Securities (MVLS) requirement under Listing Rule 5550(b)(2). The company had been notified of non-compliance on June 18, 2026, due to a failure to maintain a minimum MVLS of $35 million over 30 consecutive business days. After achieving MVLS of $35 million or greater for 10 consecutive business days from June 23 to July 7, 2026, Nasdaq confirmed the matter closed on July 8, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were mentioned. This is a routine compliance update, not a special situation.
